FROM dwd_card_transaction t0
JOIN dim_merchant t1 ON t0.merchant_id = t1.merchant_id

WITH branch_totals AS (
  SELECT
    b.branch_name,
    SUM(t.txn_amount_cny) AS amount
  FROM dwd_card_transaction AS t
  JOIN dim_branch AS b
    ON t.branch_id = b.branch_id
  WHERE
    t.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND t.transaction_status = 'POSTED'
  GROUP BY
    b.branch_name
)
SELECT
  branch_totals.branch_name,
  branch_totals.amount,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY branch_totals.amount DESC) AS amount_rank
FROM branch_totals
ORDER BY
  amount_rank

WITH branch_totals AS (
  SELECT
    b.branch_name,
    SUM(t.txn_amount_cny) AS amount
  FROM dwd_card_transaction AS t
  JOIN dim_branch AS b
    ON t.branch_id = b.branch_id
  WHERE
    t.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND t.transaction_status = 'POSTED'
  GROUP BY
    b.branch_name
)
SELECT
  branch_totals.branch_name,
  branch_totals.amount,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY branch_totals.amount DESC) AS amount_rank
FROM branch_totals
ORDER BY
  amount_rank

WITH branch_totals AS (
  SELECT
    b.branch_name,
    SUM(t.txn_amount_cny) AS amount
  FROM dwd_card_transaction AS t
  JOIN dim_branch AS b
    ON t.branch_id = b.branch_id
  WHERE
    t.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND t.transaction_status = 'POSTED'
  GROUP BY
    b.branch_name
)
SELECT
  branch_totals.branch_name,
  branch_totals.amount,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY branch_totals.amount DESC) AS amount_rank
FROM branch_totals
ORDER BY
  amount_rank

WITH branch_totals AS (
  SELECT
    b.branch_name,
    SUM(t.txn_amount_cny) AS amount
  FROM dwd_card_transaction AS t
  JOIN dim_branch AS b
    ON t.branch_id = b.branch_id
  WHERE
    t.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND t.transaction_status = 'POSTED'
  GROUP BY
    b.branch_name
)
SELECT
  branch_totals.branch_name,
  branch_totals.amount,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY branch_totals.amount DESC) AS amount_rank
FROM branch_totals
ORDER BY
  amount_rank
